chunks: And when they are reminded, they do not remember.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'when they are reminded, they do not remember'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *ghaflah* (spiritual heedlessness), where the heart becomes sealed due to persistent rejection of divine signs, preventing the external reminder from triggering internal reflection. It underscores the necessity of active contemplation (*tafakkur*) to transform mere hearing into true *dhikr*, a theme emphasized by Imams as a prerequisite for spiritual awakening.
